g.text: Ticket Booking: Seat Holds & the On-Sale Waiting Room
Left: the per-seat state machine. Right: why the waiting room exists at all.
UPDATE seats SET status='held', hold_expires_at=NOW()+'8 min' WHERE seat_id=? AND status='available'
0 rows affected = someone else already holds or booked it -- same row-level race fix as the e-commerce inventory decrement.
Sweep or lazy-expiry finds stale holds and flips them back -- nobody has to wait on a human to give up.
Without a gate: 100K browsers all race the same few thousand
rows -- the gate protects the EXPERIENCE, not just one endpoint.
